headline: Fairhaven Electronics wins quality award from industry association
body: Fairhaven Electronics received a supplier excellence award citing low defect rates and strong on-time delivery. The company plans to publish its audit results later this year.

headline: Fairhaven Electronics to present at regional manufacturing conference
body: Fairhaven Electronics will present on supply chain practices at a regional conference in Leipzig. Executives are scheduled to take questions from attendees.

headline: Regulators open inquiry into Fairhaven Electronics labeling practices
body: A regulator opened an inquiry into product labeling at Fairhaven Electronics. The company said it is cooperating and that no violations have been established.

headline: Fairhaven Electronics faces customer complaints over packaging defects
body: Several customers reported damaged goods linked to packaging changes at Fairhaven Electronics. The company said it is reviewing its packing process.

headline: Fairhaven Electronics publishes annual sustainability report
body: Fairhaven Electronics released its annual sustainability report covering energy use and waste reduction targets. The report was prepared in line with standard reporting guidelines.
